change_markers.approved_by: owner (pending: merging this change approves it)
change_markers.sealed_text: Hitting the soft cap writes status partial and a cursor; the next run resumes and does not drop unfinished names quietly.
change_markers.what_was_wrong: The second fetch (run 43287164973, 2026-11-12 19:09-21:09 UTC) hit the 120-minute job limit, which cannot hold ~26.7k requests at <=5/s. The cursor was saved only at the end, so its done-flags and the day's call count were lost; cache files were written in place, so a cancelled write could leave a truncated file that resume would skip; and the encrypt step failed on tar's 'file changed as we read it' warning (the encrypted cache was still saved).
change_markers.fix: Job limit 350 minutes; the runner stops itself after UK_REPLAY_MAX_MINUTES (320) as partial/time_budget; the cursor is saved every 25 names; every cache file is written atomically; a cache file that does not parse is fetched again; the encrypt step tolerates tar exit 1.
change_markers.unchanged: No constant, window, call weight, soft cap or scoring rule changed. Files already fetched are kept and skipped on resume.

change_markers.sealed_text: Owner sign-off: 'A name is used only when its Companies House record names the same listed company as the EODHD symbol (EPIC and leaving date consistent); otherwise it is not matched.'
change_markers.what_was_wrong: The runner still matched Companies House rows by name against the seven hard-coded probe names only, so the sealed wider scope (every store name, EPIC and leaving date consistent) was not applied.
change_markers.fix: match_ch_record attaches a store row when its EPIC equals the EODHD symbol code (or its _-suffixed delisted form) and the leaving date is within 31 days of the symbol's last bar; rows without an EPIC need a name match plus the leaving date; the seven hand-verified probe names keep the name match; two candidates match nothing. Dry run on the part-1 store: all 123 EPIC rows match only themselves.
change_markers.unchanged: No constant, window, scoring rule or call budget changed. The 31-day tolerance is the reading of 'consistent'; it is recorded here before any development score exists.
